CMHC conducts the Rental Market Survey every year in October. Some collection can run into early November. CMHC publishes the results in the following months, usually in December.

The survey covers privately initiated rental structures with at least three units:
- **Apartments:** purpose-built rental apartment buildings with three or more units.

The World Bank's World Development Indicators definition of "Labor force, total" (SL.TLF.TOTL.IN) is below. I'm giving it from memory of the WDI metadata page. I didn't check it against the live page, because my tools cover Canadian sources only.

- **Age:** The labor force is people ages 15 and older who supply labor for producing goods and services during a specified period.
- **Who is counted:** It includes people who are currently employed. It also includes people who are unemployed but seeking work, and first-time job-seekers.
- **Who may be left out:** Not everyone who works is counted. In some countries, unpaid workers, family workers and students are excluded. Some countries also don't count members of the armed forces or conscripts. National practices vary, so cross-country comparisons need care.
- **Whose estimates:** The figures are International Labour Organization (ILO) estimates. They come from the ILOSTAT database and are modeled ILO estimates. The World Bank compiles them and does not produce them. The WDI cites ILO, "ILO modelled estimates, November 2023" or the latest vintage. I can't confirm the current vintage.
